# hg slack

**What this page tells you:** every `hg slack` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Prove the provisioned slack surface: apps, secrets, channels, events edge.

## Synopsis

```text
hg slack prove <environment> [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Provisioning itself is Pulumi's: the SlackWorkspace provision Command creates each app through the raw manifest API and captures the signing secret + bot token into encrypted state — nothing is pasted. This matrix asks whether the result HOLDS: SLK001 each app's pod Secret carries both SLACK_* keys; SLK002 each app answers auth.test as the bot in the declared workspace; SLK003 each bot is a member of every pinned channel that names it; SLK004 each events endpoint refuses an unsigned POST with 401 (the no-Access edge is up and eve verifies signatures). A leg that cannot run reports unknown, never a pass.

## `hg slack prove`

```text
hg slack prove <environment> [flags]
```

The slack acceptance matrix against an environment spec.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent` | `<name>` | — | Restrict the matrix to one app. |
| `--spec` | `<file>` | — | Spec path override (default infra/environments/<env>.yaml). |

**Examples**

```bash
hg slack prove factory
hg slack prove factory --agent marketing-manager-eve
```
